items.title: Exercise the override path end-to-end
items.detail: evaluation_overrides + qi_override_evaluation are wired but unused (0 rows). Surface pending feature evaluations in the dashboard with a one-click owner override (Law 6), and confirm the override is honoured when get_context re-ranks recommendations.

items.title: Decision-code discipline
items.detail: decision_code (e.g. AD-013) is UNIQUE but optional and rarely set across the 491 decisions. Auto-assign sequential codes per scope so decisions are citable in docs and supersede chains are unambiguous.

items.title: Archive aging records
items.detail: archived_decisions / archived_features tables exist but are empty. Add a retention job that moves long-superseded decisions and skipped features into the archive so context queries stay fast as the ledger grows.

items.title: API authentication
items.detail: The Brain holds the whole ecosystem's decision history and runs with CORS allow_origins=['*']. It is safe only because it is local-only behind the QI service boundary. Add Bearer-token auth before any remote exposure.

items.title: Port allocation cleanup
items.detail: brain_config still records api_port=9010 and version=001 while the service actually runs on 9011 (build 002) after the Logitech G HUB squat. Reconcile the config rows + registry so there is one source of truth.

items.title: Per-caller rate limiting
items.detail: No throttling exists. A misbehaving agent could spam log_* or exhaust the local Ollama embedder. Add per-agent rate limits once auth identifies callers.

items.title: Backfill embeddings for legacy rows
items.detail: Decisions/features/sessions logged before a Chroma write succeeded (or while Chroma was down — embedding is best-effort) may be missing from the vector store. Add a reconcile pass that re-embeds any SQL row absent from its Chroma collection.

items.title: Re-rank context by relevance, not just recency
items.detail: get_context currently orders by same-project-first then recorded_at DESC. Blend in semantic similarity to the project's current phase so the briefing surfaces the most pertinent decisions, not merely the newest.

items.title: Confidence-weighted propagation
items.detail: feature_evaluations stores confidence + relevance_score but they are not yet used to auto-prioritise. Auto-adopt high-confidence/high-relevance recommendations and only queue the genuinely ambiguous ones for owner review.

items.title: Stale-doc enforcement loop
items.detail: docs.stale / stale_reason columns exist; wire the hive-librarian to flag docs whose content_hash drifted from their source code or that reference superseded decisions, and surface them on the compliance board.

items.title: Graph-aware search
items.detail: doc_relationships holds 2,203 typed edges (belongs_to/references/links_to/...). Extend search to traverse the graph — 'show me everything connected to this decision' — instead of returning isolated vector hits.

items.title: Poll-log retention
items.detail: poll_log (18,718) and compliance_log (46,654) grow unbounded. Add a rolling retention/VACUUM policy so qi_brain.db stays lean.

items.title: Brain self-state in the ecosystem snapshot
items.detail: The Brain logs every other project's state but rarely logs its own. Have the poller record qi_brain's own project_state so the snapshot reflects the backbone too.

items.title: Richer /api/status for Mission Control
items.detail: Expose poller last-run, distiller queue depth, Chroma per-collection counts, and provider reachability in one endpoint for the QI Hive Mission Control board.
